messages:
kevin: FYI NexaSupply updated the manifest. ETA changed and 4 units are DOA. They can release 36 units today, 4 to follow after RMA. Need allocation plan for eu-west1 vs eu-central

nate (NexaSupply): Apologies. Original ETA 2026-04-18 slipped. Customs detained one pallet. We can air 36 units now (AWB: 9876543210). DOA count: 4. Replacement ETA 3-4 weeks post-inspection unless you mark RMA as expedite.

maria: Which SKUs failed? H100 or A100?

nate (NexaSupply): DOAs list: 2 x H100-80GB, 2 x A100-80GB. Shipment split H100=24, A100=16.

leo: Reminder we committed 40 GPUs to EU Dedicated for Q3. Active pool is 38. Losing 2 short-term will violate commitments for some tenants.

jess: Can we operate with 36 for a few days? Prioritize eu-central for latency-critical routes. If needed shift 8 from eu-west to eu-central.

ash: Inventory snapshot: 6 spare H100 in staging (us-west). Cross-region air transfer approx $2k/unit + duties. Might be cheaper than vendor expedite if they don't cover freight.

kevin: Options: 1) Accept 36 now and run tight, 2) Hold allocation (customer impact), 3) Escalate RMA inspection to shorten replacement ETA.

maria: We should push vendor for bench logs + photos and request expedite. If they fast-track inspection maybe replacements in ~10 days.

nate (NexaSupply): We can fast-track inspection if you mark RMA as "expedite". Please send failed serials and bench logs. We'll issue RMA IDs and provide return AWB on inspection start. Example RMA format: RMA-2026-0423-XX.

kevin: I'll open internal incident and notify impacted customers. @ops-bot create task: estimate cross-region transfer cost/time.

ops-bot: Created task INF-5423: "Estimate cross-region transfer cost & lead time for up to 8 GPUs"  assignee: ash  due: 2026-04-20.

jess: Loop in finance — if we front freight costs for cross-ship vendor should credit or adjust invoice.

ash: Quick calc: 8 GPUs us-west->eu-central by air ~= $16k + duties. If vendor covers expedited freight that's preferred. If not, cross-ship + customs may still be faster overall.

maria: Check partner cache in AMS (our partner pool) before moving from US.

leo: Ops note: if we move GPUs between regions, tag allocations so autoscaler doesn't rebalance and trigger capacity churn.

kevin: Agreed. Jess, hold any autoscaler changes until allocation confirmed. Request vendor provide photos + logs by EOD so we can mark RMA expedite.

nate (NexaSupply): Photos and failed serials sent via email. RMA IDs assigned: RMA-2026-0423-101, RMA-2026-0423-102, RMA-2026-0423-103, RMA-2026-0423-104. Return AWB for DOAs: 987-RET-444. We'll cover expedited freight if you mark as expedite.

kevin: Added serials to our tracker and booked air for 36 units (AWB 9876543210).

jess: Pinged finance asking for vendor credit/holdback terms. :+1:

ash: If vendor confirms replacement within <=14 days we skip cross-transfer. If >14 days we authorize transfer and charge cost center.

maria: Consensus: accept 36 now, mark RMA "expedite inspection". Ash to finalize transfer cost if vendor slips.

kevin: Action items: kevin - update customers & RMA tracker; nate - expedite inspection; ash - finalize transfer estimate (INF-5423); ops-bot - create subtasks; jess - coordinate finance. I'll update #customer-success once we have replacement ETA. :thumbsup:
